title: Grateful Dead Live at The Scope on 1982-04-03
lineage: Transfer: MAC > Nakamichi CR-5A (Dolby-B in) > Edirol FA-66 > Wavelab 2448 > CD-Wave (24bit output) > TLH > FLAC 2448 tagged.
taper: Concert recording by Rip Tompkins, & with thanks to Richie Stankiewicz!
source: FOB Beyers mics > Sony TC-D5M > TDK MA-90's.

ai_review.summary: Wonderful recording featuring a surprising Loser with phased bass and a unique Scarlet > Fire jam that keep the show fresh.
ai_review.review: The reviewer finds this 1982 show both musically intriguing and technically solid, praising the excellent surprises like Phil’s phased‑bass on “Loser” and an unusual Scarlet/Fire transition. While noting a few moments of confusion, the overall impression is very positive with a high‑energy performance that feels fresh for listeners new to the era.

ai_rating.rationale: Only one detailed review rating the show 4 stars; it highlights strong musical moments and a wonderful recording, leading to an overall four‑star assessment.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewer calls the recording "wonderful" with no noted flaws, indicating clear and well‑balanced audio.

show_quality.setlist_flow: The set includes unexpected transitions (e.g., Scarlet into Fire) that add freshness; overall flow is praised despite a few confusing moments.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Mentioned in context of swapping sides with Phil, suggesting a different instrumental arrangement for this show.
band_member_comments.Phil: Praised for his phased‑bass on "Loser," bringing a new texture to the song.
